LESSON: REPRODUCTION IN PLANTS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Living things and their Environment
Topic 2.3: Reproduction in plants

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Reproduction in plants
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does reproduction in plants occur?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain fertilisation and fruit formation in flowering plants
2. recognise the role of flowers in nature

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Reproduction in plants

Teach
• Observe Reproduction in plants in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Reproduction in plants (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Reproduction in plants.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Reproduction in plants.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Reproduction in plants.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• explain fertilisation and fruit formation in flowering plants
• recognise the role of flowers in nature

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Reproduction in plants.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Reproduction in plants: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does reproduction in plants occur?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain fertilisation and fruit formation in flowering plants
• recognise the role of flowers in nature

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
